moat_against: SpaceX Starlink direct-to-cell already live with 650+ satellites, own launch vehicles, deep capital
Only 13 satellites in orbit vs ~45 targeted by early 2027 — network effect unbuilt, timeline already slipped
Launch dependence on SpaceX, its direct competitor, after Blue Origin New Glenn grounding
Extreme capital intensity funded by dilution — share count +76.8%/yr
moat_for: Largest phased arrays in LEO — full broadband to unmodified phones, not text-only
60+ MNO partnerships covering 3B+ subscribers — distribution without consumer acquisition cost
Patented architecture and spectrum/regulatory position; first-mover window before Amazon Leo (2028)
~$1.3B contracted backlog including US government awards above $100M
moat_justification: Technology lead is real (largest phased arrays in LEO, full broadband to unmodified phones where the live competitor is text-first) and 60+ MNO partnerships covering 3B+ subscribers give distribution without consumer acquisition cost, but there is no network effect until the constellation exists: only 13 satellites in orbit vs ~45 needed, SpaceX Starlink direct-to-cell is already live with 650+ satellites, owns the launch stack AST now depends on after the New Glenn grounding, and has effectively unlimited capital; Amazon Leo is entering from 2028. Nothing has yet survived contact with a paying mass market.
name: AST SpaceMobile, Inc.
one_liner: Pre-commercial satellite broadband with a real technology lead and moat 4/10, but owner's earnings are negative on every base (TTM -$6.06/sh) and the share count grows 76.8%/yr — no positive price clears the 15% hurdle until it prints a positive-OE year.
